recipe.visualDefinition: A medium close-up portrait of a man in rugged attire set against a hazy, industrial background, featuring a two-tier typographic hierarchy with a large, distressed sans-serif title and a smaller, handwritten subtitle.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's dark jacket anchors the bottom half of the frame against a light sky.
Large block lettering spans the top third, creating a header effect.
Handwritten script overlaps the primary title to create depth.
The subject's gaze is directed away from the camera, creating a contemplative mood.
coreInvariants: Desaturated color grade with cool blue-grey tones.
Distressed, weathered texture applied to all text elements.
High-contrast lighting on the subject's face.
Soft-focus industrial background elements like water towers.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered medium shot, subject occupies the bottom two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's dark, textured jacket provides a heavy base for the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large white text at the top, moves down to the subject's face, then follows his gaze toward the right edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample space in the upper corners around the primary text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cool grey and muted blue in the background and sky.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black and charcoal in the subject's clothing.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted rust-red or clay-brown in the secondary text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast between the white text and dark clothing.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to earthy and industrial tones

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy, condensed sans-serif and casual brush script.
letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses thick, uniform strokes with square terminals.
Secondary text mimics quick, dry-brush handwriting with varying line weights.
Both styles feature heavy distressing, including speckles and erosion.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Erosion patterns are unique to each letter to avoid repetitive digital look.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a rigid, industrial sans-serif with a fluid, organic brush script.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and condensed structure for the primary title.
Matches the raw, handmade feel of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a medium shot of a man with a beard wearing a grey flat cap and a black quilted utility jacket. The background should be a hazy, desaturated industrial landscape with a soft-focus water tower. Lighting should be bright but diffused, coming from the side. Apply a subtle film grain and cool color grade.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, condensed, white uppercase sans-serif text across the top. Apply a heavy 'weathered' or 'eroded' texture to the letters. Overlap this with a smaller, hand-written brush script in dark grey, with one character highlighted in a muted rust-red.

verificationChecks: Is the primary text heavily distressed?
Does the script text overlap the block text?
Is the color palette desaturated and cool-toned?
Is the background industrial and out of focus?

adjustableVariables: Subject's clothing style (e.g., denim instead of quilted jacket)
Accent color in the script text
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the artist

mustAchieve: Balanced composition between heavy text and subject

postGenerationChecks: Check that the text erosion doesn't make the words unreadable.
Ensure the subject's jacket maintains detail in the shadows.
Verify the script text feels like a separate layer from the block text.
Confirm the background blur is natural and not a simple Gaussian blur.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a rugged male portrait in an industrial setting with a header of distressed, condensed sans-serif type overlapped by organic, hand-drawn script.
